subject: Sentry Q3 capacity uplift — benchmarking window & counteroffer
messages:
From: Alexandra Peters <apeters@sentry.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@sentry.ai>, Procurement Sentry <procurement@sentry.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sentry Q3 capacity uplift: initial ask and bakeoff window

SoojIN — thanks again for the demo last week. We had an internal sync and theres momentum to increase our committed capacity for Q3. A few items from our side: 

- Were targeting a 2x uplift on peak token throughput starting July 1.
- Before we commit, Procurement needs a short bakeoff: cost-per-token and latency under our 99th pct load (key paths: conversation + reranking).
- Security is OK with your SOC2 paperwork; they want a quick data-retention confirmation.

Can Redwood run a focused benchmark the week of May 3? Wed like to invite a neutral observer and will share a representative request trace. Also, can you send an updated terms/counteroffer including a short-term uplift rate and a trial discount?

Attachments: sample-trace.json (we will upload separately)

Best,
Alexandra Peters
Head of Platform Engineering
Sentry.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Peters <apeters@sentry.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentry Q3 capacity uplift: initial ask and bakeoff window

Alexandra — appreciate the clarity and the timeline. We can absolutely run the focused benchmark wk of May 3. Proposed plan below: 

1) Pre-bakeoff calibration (May 3): ingest your trace, map to model variants, and confirm latency SLO targets.
2) Bakeoff execution (May 4–5): run Redwood-hosted vs competitor baseline across three scenarios (chat small, chat long, rerank heavy).
3) Analysis & exec summary (May 6): deliver CSV results, summary deck, and suggested config (caching/batching/quantization recommended).

Regarding terms: Ben, can you prepare a short counteroffer that includes a 6-week trial discount on incremental capacity and an uplift commitment discount if Sentry signs by June 15? Ill share a pre-populated MAP (Sentry-MAP-v1.xlsx) and the benchmark acceptance criteria.

Well also note data-retention: Redwood will log perf traces for 30 days by default (exportable); if you need longer retention we can add a compliance add-on.

Cc-ing Ben/Marissa/Rishi to move terms/ops.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-benchmark-proposal.txt (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Peters <apeters@sentry.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Procurement Sentry <procurement@sentry.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 13:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Counteroffer: short-term uplift pricing + contingency credits

Alexandra / Procurement team — draft counteroffer attached (redwood-save-offer-v2.pdf). Highlights:

- 8% incremental discount on the first 3 months of uplift (applies to increased committed units).
- Trial window: 6 weeks of uplifted capacity with a 30% performance-credits bank if we miss agreed 99th-pct latency by >25% in any scenario. Credits usable as invoice offsets.
- If Sentry signs a 12-month addendum committing to uplifted baseline by June 15, we extend a further 5% committed-rate discount.

Operational notes: Marissa will run the bakeoff lab and deliver the CSV; Rishi will prepare a quick runbook to ensure trace parity between Redwood and your environment.

Process ask: Procurement, please confirm the decision criteria matrix (cost, latency, availability, security escrow) by Friday so we can prioritize the test matrix.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-save-offer-v2.pdf

From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@sentry.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alexandra Peters <apeters@sentry.ai>, Procurement Sentry <procurement@sentry.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentry Q3 capacity uplift: initial ask and bakeoff window

SoojIN / Ben — quick clarifying items from engineering: 

- For the rerank-heavy scenario we need to include cold-kv-cache start-ups (95th/99th cold path). Will Redwood replicate a cold-start run?
- Can you map the model variants you expect to use for the test (e.g., rwd-small-q4 vs rwd-ops-q8) so we know the cost buckets?

Procurement: we will prioritize the acceptance matrix by Friday. Also, excited to have a credit-based SLA if latency misses happen — please confirm how credits are calculated.

Thanks,
Evan
Senior Reliability Engineer
Sentry.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@sentry.ai>, Alexandra Peters <apeters@sentry.ai>, Procurement Sentry <procurement@sentry.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentry Q3 capacity uplift: initial ask and bakeoff window

Evan / team — answers inline and lab schedule update below.

- Cold-start runs: yes, well include a controlled cold-cache scenario at the start of each test day. Marissa will mark the CSV rows as COLD vs WARM.
- Model mapping: we propose the following: rwd-latency-q4 (low-quant, higher perf) for chat small; rwd-ops-q8 for chat long and rerank. Full mapping included in Sentry-MAP-v1.xlsx attached.
- Credits calc: credit bank = invoice dollars equivalent to the percentage shortfall on SLA multiplied by a 30% factor (example in PDF). We intend to run credits automatically against the next billing cycle; details in redwood-save-offer-v2.pdf.

Bakeoff lab schedule (May 4–5):
- May 4 09:00–12:00: chat-small & chat-long (cold + warm runs)
- May 4 13:00–17:00: rerank-heavy (including cold-starts)
- May 5 09:00–12:00: repeat for statistical sig and competitor baseline
- May 6 14:00: executive summary + acceptance call (30 min)

Next steps: Procurement, confirm acceptance criteria matrix by EOD Friday (May 7). Well upload the benchmark harness and CSV template to the Drive link and share the DocuSign for the test addendum after acceptance.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sentry-MAP-v1.xlsx; sentry-benchmark-raw-results.csv (template)
